Quote: "Extension over ma200 and run_10d are weights, not faults." Not in my method: C24 names 70-100% above the 200-day as a climax signal, and entry 15.02 vs ma200 8.4 is beyond it. W/D/H1 HH/HL and 0.99 under the 20-day high do not clear that. No concession.

Quote: "day_vol 0.94 is an unmet confirmation, not failed." Under C16 that is the same thing: no buy. W and D HH/HL at 0.07 under the 20-bar high is a base at its pivot, but day_vol 0.94 is under 1.40 and H1 is below EMA9. Unconfirmed is not buyable.
